text.text_excerpt: I didn't have any problems here the 3-4 times I wondered in here. Shame I was staying almost across the street and this spot does not come up when u yelp search. So this is a liquor store, beer, wine, check cashing in the back, and snacks. I was just fussing to my babe about some spot charging me $10 for a beer when I spotted this place. Line is long and yep there are folks outside drinking beer out of paper bags. Half of the folks were tourists and invited me to get a beer n join them. I did btw lol. So good beer selection and not just Louisiana beer which I'm not a fan of. I got me a tall can of voodoo ipa and a bag of cheetos for $3. Now we re talking. They have a big checkout screen u...

This place is sketchy as hell but they cash checks for super cheap and do money orders FOR FREE! Western Union is cheap and fairly quick. Look, you will most likely get hustled going in and out of the store but just keep your wits about you, don't engage in conversation with drunkies, and keep your purse close to your side. The clerks are good about getting you in and out quickly. Parking is pretty much impossible so park a few blocks away and walk or do as I do and bike (just make sure you lock it up).

Great spot! Don't get your hopes up for a comfortable atmosphere but the security guard will keep you safe. Best place for a cheap beer or build you own cocktail. Free ice and cups. Convenient location to French quarter and mid city. Rather give them my money than Walgreens too.
